description.value:
You expel a corrosive breeze filling a 15-foot cube extending from you. Each creature in the area must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d4 acid damage and being blinded until the end of your next turn on a failure, or taking half as much damage with no blindness on a success.

Cast with a tech slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d4 for each slot level above 1st.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 1
